_comment_variant: HYDRA Variant B — Brandon Trojan Horse stack with NARROW 5/10pt widths (same as variant C). CURRENT STATE (since the 2026-09-02 slot-audit change): B is the LIVE paper seat at 7 contracts, 6-slot entry grid (09:45–12:45, 30min grid, 11:15 REMOVED). C is dry-run-shadow, still running the original schedule (kept as a control -- see the vix_regime._comment_max_entries note below for the finding). History: 2026-05-13 cut from 7 slots to 4 after a 5/4-5/12 review found commission drag dominated at the original 7-slot x 15c sizing (each Brandon narrow-spread entry pays $2.50/leg x 4 legs x 15c = $150 round-trip; 7 slots = $1,050/day in fees alone). Same 2026-05-13 change: contracts_per_entry 15 -> 10 (same commission-drag logic). 2026-07-01: widened back 4 -> 7 base slots as the per-slot tester for slot_edge (attempt all 7 every zone, gates filter). Later re-sized 10c -> 7c for the live swap. 2026-09-02: dropped 11:15 (7 -> 6 slots) after a per-slot P&L audit found it B's clear worst performer, independently confirmed on C. Pre-2026-05-05 design used HYDRA wide widths; retired because Brandon GEX-ADJ + put-only VIX gate combined to skip B on most days. NOTE: this checked-in file is a sample/template, not deploy-authoritative — the VM's live copy is edited directly there (see CLAUDE.md Config Files) and may diverge from this value.
_comment_credentials: IBKR OAuth credentials are loaded from systemd $CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY on the VM, or env vars in dev. Not in this file.

strategy._comment_widths: MKT-027 settings here are unused at runtime — strategy.brandon.narrow_spread.enabled=true overrides _get_vix_adjusted_spread_width with Brandon's 5/10pt rule. Values kept aligned with variant A's VM config (max=75pt) for consistency / debugging clarity.
strategy._comment_put_only_max_vix: Lifted from HYDRA-baseline 15 → 28 because Brandon GEX-ADJ skip-and-route-as-put-only is a core part of his strategy when SPX is inside the call accel zone — capping the fallback at VIX < 15 would block it on most days (VIX 15-25 is normal, not extreme).
strategy._comment_credit_floors: Lowered ~10× vs original variant B because narrow_spread.enabled=true makes the IC 5pt or 10pt wide instead of 75pt — credits scale roughly proportionally with spread width, so HYDRA's standard $0.20/$0.30 floors would skip every entry.
strategy._comment_safety_caps: ORDER-006 caps for B's current 7-slot grid at 7c (live since the 2026-07-24 swap; was 4-slot/10c before). Per-order cap 15 leaves headroom; per-underlying cap 600 was raised (60→200→600) once B4 made the cap COUNT overlay contracts too, so it must clear ICs (7c × 4 legs × up to 7 slots) plus up to ~14 overlay contracts without ever blocking legitimate defense.
strategy._comment_min_bp_per_ic: ORDER-004 BP-per-contract floor lowered $5000 → $500 because narrow 5pt × $100 = $500/contract margin (Brandon narrow-spread economics). Default is sized for wide HYDRA-baseline (50pt × $100 = $5000); without this override, every entry trips required vs available — exactly what blocked all 7 entries on 2026-05-06.
strategy._comment_pnl_bounds: DATA-003 sanity bounds, scaled for narrow-spread × 7c (re-sized from 10c at the 2026-07-24 live swap). PER-CONTRACT figures multiplied by contracts at runtime: max_pnl_per_ic 100 × 7c = $700 ceiling (covers full credit on 10pt high-VIX worst case), min_pnl_per_ic -1000 × 7c = -$7,000 floor (covers max loss 10pt × $100 × 7c = $7k). Without these overrides the 1c-baseline -$3000 floor would silently skip stop checks once a real drawdown developed.
strategy._comment_downday_callonly: OFF on B (and should be OFF on C) — Brandon GEX adjuster is the sole side-selection logic on the Brandon stack; HYDRA's down-day call-only override would conflict with GEX zone reads.
strategy._comment_mkt046: 2026-08-28: disabled the MKT-046 anti-spike breach-confirmation wait (was a hardcoded 10s, now configurable). A full-history study (16 delayed stops on B, 6 on C, 3 months) found ZERO cases where waiting avoided a stop that didn't happen anyway, and the wait made the eventual exit price WORSE in 19 of 22 delayed stops (never better) -- see bots/hydra/__init__.py version history. 0.0 means the breach must still be observed on 2 consecutive ticks (not a same-tick instant stop) before executing -- matches the confirmation code's own original documented intent of 'two consecutive heartbeat cycles'. The >=2x severity bypass (separate mechanism) is unaffected either way. A/C/F/G keep the default 10.0 pending their own review.

vix_regime._comment_max_entries: 2026-07-01: widened 4->7 base slots (09:45-12:45, 30min grid) as the per-slot TESTER for slot_edge; attempt all 7 every zone, gates filter. Was [4,4,3,2]. 2026-09-02: dropped to 6 slots -- removed 11:15 after a per-slot audit found it B's worst performer (60% WR, -$3,538 net over 20 entries) AND independently confirmed bad on C too, with losses clustering on the SAME calendar days for both variants (07-13/07-16/08-19/08-28), ruling out per-variant noise. C left running 11:15 unchanged as an ongoing control for this finding.
vix_regime._comment_min_credits: Lowered ~10× vs variant A because narrow_spread.enabled=true makes the IC 5pt or 10pt wide instead of 75pt — credits scale roughly proportionally with spread width.

directional_pivot._comment: Disabled in variant B — Brandon GEX-breach exit (live) plays the same role.

brandon._comment: Same Brandon stack as variant C (narrow 5/10pt widths). All Brandon features LIVE: TP, narrow_spread, GEX strike adjuster, GEX breach exit, defensive overlay. Only shadow behavior is hydra_stop_shadow for head-to-head comparison.
brandon._comment_disable_tightening: MKT-020/MKT-022 progressive tightening is HYDRA's credit-chasing mechanism — it walks strikes inward when initial credit < floor. Brandon's strategy picks strikes per GEX zones and accepts low credit at safe strikes; if credit < gate the entry should SKIP, not move strikes onto a wall. 2026-05-07 incident: tightener walked B's E#5/E#6 puts from 125pt OTM (safe) to 35-40pt OTM (right on the 7330 GEX wall) chasing credit; when SPX broke the wall at 13:26 the resulting 4 breach exits cost ~$8.7K. With this flag set, MKT-020/MKT-022 skip on B and the strike stays where Brandon GEX-ADJ wants it.
brandon._comment_delta_target: Brandon-faithful strike selection: anchor short strikes to a delta target read from Polygon's option chain (8 delta default, inherited from strategy.target_delta). Replaces HYDRA's 'starting OTM = N × expected_move' approximation, which underestimates real risk on low-VIX days. When enabled, _calculate_strikes asks the GEX profile for the strike at the configured delta; downstream HYDRA pipeline (Brandon GEX-ADJ for accel-zone skip, narrow-spread width, MKT-045 chain snap) runs on top unchanged. Falls back to OTM-multiplier if Polygon greeks are unavailable.

gex._comment_persistence: 2026-08-14: require 2 independent GEX reads to agree before an accel-zone SKIP fires (same fix flipped on C on 2026-08-12; C ran 3 days clean, and a counterfactual replay of 2026-08-14 confirmed the gate would have rescued 2 of B real entries today). See bots/hydra/__init__.py version history.

defensive_overlay._comment_trigger_distance_pts: 2026-08-19: tightened 25 -> 15 after a 9-event replay found 25pt arms the hedge well before real danger on a 5-10pt-wide B/C spread (0/9 events defended a side that was ever actually breached; the 3 realized-loss events all fired 11:02-11:16 ET on threats that evaporated). 15pt sits near a ~2.5-3x multiple of the narrow-spread width (matching this codebase's own OTM-multiplier convention) while staying above the just-tightened 10pt MKT-047 flatten cushion. Confidence is LOW-MEDIUM -- the 9-event sample reduces to ~5-6 independent moments (B/C fired on several identical underlying ticks in parallel) and the 3 known real stop-loss-breach days have zero recoverable hedge data, so this is a monitored/instrumented change, not a settled number. Distance-at-tick logging added alongside this change so a future replay has real data instead of inferred bounds. See bots/hydra/__init__.py version history.
defensive_overlay._comment_confirm_staging: 2026-09-01: PROMOTED to match C's staged trial after a real trading-week review (60+ genuine watch-eligible moments on C over 2026-08-25 through 2026-09-01, zero confirmed placements, no evidence of dangerous under-defense on the one live threatened position checked) plus the 2026-08-31 evidence that the old flat-0.05-no-locality gate let 3 real hedges fire on B in one afternoon under materially the same conditions C rejected all week. Now matches C exactly: confirm_seconds=10, severity_bypass_distance_pts=5 (a genuinely fast/severe threat still hedges immediately), use_adjuster_gex_gate=true (reuses the strike adjuster's tuned accel_min_pct/accel_peak_locality_pts/accel_peak_persistence_enabled instead of the old rubber-stamp-prone flat 0.05-no-locality check). Reversible: set confirm_seconds=0, severity_bypass_distance_pts=0, use_adjuster_gex_gate=false to restore the prior behavior. See bots/hydra/__init__.py version history.
defensive_overlay._comment_debit_spread_disabled: 2026-08-25: the MORNING debit-spread hedge has a clean, consistently-losing real-dollar record on B with zero offsetting wins found anywhere; the AFTERNOON butterfly's one clearly-attributable large outcome was a genuine win (a real ~2.6pt pin) with no comparable clean loss data against it. Full sourcing, exact numbers, and methodology (not just an unlocatable 'audit' -- every figure here is independently reproducible from the log lines / SQL queries cited): docs/postmortems/2026-08-25_brandon_hedge_pnl_reconstruction.md. Trade-off, not a bug: from entry open until butterfly_cutoff, a threatened position now has NO overlay hedge at all (previously the debit spread was always live in that window) -- the credit+buffer stop remains the backstop throughout regardless. Reversible: set back to true if the routine-mode data changes. See also bots/hydra/__init__.py version history.

hydra_stop_shadow._comment: When true, computes HYDRA's existing credit+buffer stop every tick in parallel without acting. First fire per side per day is Telegrammed for head-to-head comparison against Brandon's GEX breach (which IS the live stop in B/C).

eod_flatten._comment_skip_otm_pts: 2026-08-18: skip_otm_pts lowered 20 -> 10 after a 19-event MKT-047 historical audit (all variants, back to the mechanism's 2026-06-17 birth) found a 0/19 win rate flattening vs just holding to expiry (net cost ~$805 in the recoverable window) and a real-money 0-for-2 on 2026-08-17 (B lost $175 flattening two puts that both settled OTM). A 15/10/5pt sensitivity re-check on the same 19 events found 10pt recovers ~52% of the historical gap while still protecting the one 2026-08-17 trade that came within 0.36pt of the strike at settlement (E4) -- 15pt changes nothing on that trade, 5pt would have let it ride. See bots/hydra/__init__.py version history.

external_price_feed._comment: Yahoo Finance fallback for VIX/SPX (shared/external_price_feed.py). shared/config_loader.py defaults enabled=false in cloud/LIVE. HYDRA's own VIX read goes through self.broker.get_vix_price() -> IBClient.get_vix_price and does NOT consume this key — the external_price_feed feed is only wired into the shared/apollo path (services/apollo/market_data.py), so this flag has no effect on HYDRA's spread-width / vix_regime math today. (The old Saxo 'NoAccess' / FullTradingAndChat-contention rationale is obsolete post-IBKR cutover.)
